scope: Scientific comparison of matching hypotheses, coherent linkage uncertainty, historical availability and inclusion in customer observations.
criterion_findings: Identity, ownership and network relations are separated from computed matching groups; event/availability/storage clocks, joint linkage variance and inclusion are explicit. Documented AWS, QualityStage, Databricks, Snowflake and scoped Splink alternatives accompany exact monetary and selection examples.

Each behavior retains inspected source identity and version limits. Confidence scores are not relabeled calibrated map probabilities; uninspected matching mechanics, current-service/cutoff equality, rights and native qualification remain provisional.
limitations: The comparison does not establish exhaustive observation-software coverage or an implemented adapter.
Mapping probabilities, contrasts, within-map noise, inclusion rates and money are authored assumptions rather than vendor or bank results.
Cutoff provenance, commercial/native qualification, sampling calibration, rendered visual and final acceptance remain open.
revisit_trigger: New matching or timestamp source, different identity/relationship/availability/inclusion law, qualified native adapter or truthful audit.

evidence.anchor: Primary source and exact example review
